practiceBody: Umsebenzi omuhle ukuqeqesha amakhono akho okukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa! Kungani ungabamema nabangane bakho ukuzama i-Toonleer nabo?
howto1p3: Bese sihlukanisa imiphumela ngo: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 no-9, ukufinyelela inombolo yokuqala.
howto1p4: Ukuqeda i-Toonleer usuku nosuku kuzokusiza ukuthuthukisa inkulumo-mpendulo yakho kanye nesivinini semathematics engqondo.
howto2p3: I-cursor izohamba ngokuzenzakalela iye endaweni yokuthwala.
howto3p3: I-cursor izosuka ngokuzenzakalela izithwalo ezingadingekile, njengoba inombolo elandelayo ikhanda ngo-0, futhi impendulo elandelayo icaca ukuthi "6"
howto4p2: I-2 ayingeneli ku-1, ngakho sibala: 11 ÷ 2 = 5 insalela 1, ngakho sibhala "5" sithwale "1"
howto4p3: I-cursor izohamba ngokuzenzakalela iye endaweni yokuthwala.
howto5p2: I-7 ayingeneli ku-6, ngakho sibhala "0" ngaphandle kwesithwalo esingadingekile "6".
howto5p3: Bese sibala 61 ÷ 7 = 8 insalela 5, ngakho sibhala "8" sithwale "5".
howto6p1: Ipalisa ngalinye lilahlekisa inkanyezi (noma impilo) futhi lapho inkanyezi yakho noma isikhathi siqeda, umchezo uphela.
howto6p2: Kunemigqa eyi-16 yokuqeda. I-Toonleer yakho engcono kakhulu izobalwa ngokwemigqa eminingi eqediwe, nokuphoswa okuncane, kulandele isikhathi esisheshayo.
